Class ChromaticAberrationFX

Namespace
LibGFX.Graphics.PostProcessing

LibGFX.dll

Applies a chromatic aberration post-processing effect to a rendered scene, simulating color channel separation for visual distortion or stylistic purposes.

public class ChromaticAberrationFX : IPostProcessFilter

Remarks

Use this class to add chromatic aberration to a post-processing stack in a rendering pipeline. The effect can be customized using the Intensity, RadialAmount, and Direction properties, or by selecting from several built-in presets for common use cases. ChromaticAberrationFX is typically used to enhance realism, create glitch effects, or emphasize dramatic moments in games and visual applications. This class is not thread-safe and should be used on the rendering thread.

Remarks

A value of 1.0 applies the effect fully, while lower values reduce the effect proportionally. Values less than 0 may produce undefined results depending on the effect implementation.
